title: Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish from Saudi Arabia, featuring succulent lamb kebabs grilled to perfection. Serve with a side of rice and vegetables for a complete meal.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure the lamb is at room temperature before grilling.

ingredients.name: Spicy saffron threads
ingredients.notes: Soak the saffron in 1 tablespoon of hot water before mixing with the yogurt.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt for better flavor.

ingredients.name: Plain yogurt
ingredients.notes: Mix with the soaked saffron threads.

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, saffron mixture, sumac, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and mix until they are evenly coated with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they are cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the kebabs with a side of rice and vegetables, garnished with chopped parsley and a dollop of yogurt.
